data.name: greentrade.tech
data.description: GreenTrade (GreenTrade Impact GmbH) is a Berlin-based marketplace founded in 2022 that provides forward financing for nature- and tech-based carbon projects via long-term offtake agreements, sometimes tokenised on blockchain. It curates a portfolio of projects for corporate buyers seeking reduction and removal credits, rather than operating removal technology itself.
